description: This file defines the class BuzzPostDecorator, which is a decorator for the BuzzPost entity within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides methods to set associated employee data based on employee number, and uses traits for ORM helper functions.

classes.name: BuzzPostDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around the BuzzPost entity, providing additional methods for entity management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a BuzzPost entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the BuzzPost entity based on the employee's number.
